anika r: kicking off a quiet rollout of ff `route-priority-lite`. plan: 0% -> 1% -> 8% -> 30% with holds and autopause. runbook: https://confluence.redwood/KB/route-priority-lite
omar s: ack. rollback thresholds: p95 +20% for 4m or error-rate >1.4x. pin fallback config before ramping.
release-bot: draft release note added.
deploy-bot: job 6221 queued by anika r. image: rwd/route-lite:v20260327. dry-run ok.
anika r: pinning fallback: `rwdctl config set routing.fallback v1 --pin`
deploy-bot: feature flag route-priority-lite -> 1% applied.
omar s: holding. small p99 jitter but p95 steady. starting eval quick-check.
sre-oncall: standing by; autopause rule set (p95 delta 22% for 3m).
deploy-bot: advancing to 8% after hold. flag -> 8% applied.
omar s: noticed one pod with KV churn; pushing tiny patch to reduce cache retention (image v20260327a). canary swap on that pod.
deploy-bot: canary image swap executed; patched pod stable. memory back to normal.
anika r: proceed to 30% planned ramp in 20m if green. leaving rollback snippet in runbook: `rwdctl ff set route-priority-lite 0 --reason "auto-rollback" && rwdctl config unpin routing.fallback`
omar s: thanks. monitoring dashboards and evals.
sre-oncall: will escalate if autopause fires. :eyes:
